summary: צְמָרִי designates a member of the Zemarite clan. Genesis 10:18 uses the definite singular to name the whole clan among the families of Canaan.

senses.definition: A member of the Zemarite clan, with the singular also designating the clan collectively.

evidence.note: The Zemarite stands between the Arvadite and the Hamathite in the list described as the families of the Canaanite.
